title: HOW TO PRAY FOR THE SICK
openLoop: The ONE question Jesus always asked before healing anyone

scenes.point: Jesus isn't here in person — but through YOU He heals
scenes.teaser: The mistake everyone makes when someone's hurting
scenes.imagePrompt: Cinematic illustration: a gentle hand resting on a sick person's shoulder with warm golden light radiating from the touch, hopeful, painterly, no text, 16:9

scenes.point: “What would you like Jesus to do for you?”
scenes.imagePrompt: Cinematic illustration: a child kneeling beside a sick elderly person's bed, gently asking, warm window light, compassionate, painterly, no text, 16:9

scenes.point: Some don't want healing — anyone who asks, receives
scenes.teaser: The mood-swing trap most people fall for
scenes.imagePrompt: Cinematic illustration: open cupped hands receiving a soft beam of golden light from above, dark background, hopeful, painterly, no text, 16:9

scenes.point: Don't guess what's wrong — ask. You might be surprised
scenes.teaser: What Jesus did when a dying girl needed Him
scenes.imagePrompt: Cinematic illustration: two children talking gently on a bench, one listening with care, warm light, painterly, no text, 16:9

scenes.point: Jesus had compassion — He let people explain their need
scenes.teaser: Heal like Jesus — the one habit
scenes.imagePrompt: Cinematic illustration: Jesus kneeling with compassion beside a sick child, warm radiant light, hopeful, painterly, no text, 16:9

scenes.point: Always ask what they want — then you heal like Jesus
scenes.imagePrompt: Cinematic illustration: a glowing sunrise over a winding path leading toward distant light, hopeful, painterly, no text, 16:9
